{{Current events|year=2018|month=11|day=4|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Minya bus attack]]
**[[Egyptian National Police|Egyptian Police]] kill 19 Islamist militants accused of involvement in an attack on [[Coptic Orthodox Church of Alexandria|Coptic Christian]]s in central [[Egypt]] two days ago. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-46090104 (BBC)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Ross Edgley]] becomes the first person to swim around [[Great Britain]]. The {{convert|1,780|mi|km|adj=on}} swim lasted 156 days. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-46088884 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 European floods]]
**Heavy floods affect [[Palermo]] in [[Sicily]], [[Italy]], killing twelve people. The total death toll of the floods and strong winds in the country rises to 31 people. [http://www.teleacras.com/wp1/2018/11/05/maltempo-in-sicilia-12-morti/ (Teleacras)]
* Nearly seven tonnes of C9 [[aromatic hydrocarbon]] are leaked into the ocean at a port in [[Quangang District]], [[Quanzhou]], [[China]] when a petrochemical company loads the cargo from its terminal into a chemical tanker and the aged hose coupling gasket breaks. Nearby [[aquaculture]] farms are contaminated, resulting in huge loss. Many fishermen and residents get sick from the leaked chemical, and 52 of them are hospitalized. Local authorities are accused of playing down the severity of the leakage. Discussion of the accident is suppressed on [[Weibo]] after the accident has become a hot topic. [https://splash247.com/chemical-tanker-leak-causes-chaos-at-quanzhou-port/ (Splash 247)][http://www.stheadline.com/inews-content.php?cat=e&nid=249229 (Singtao Daily)][http://shanghaiist.com/2018/11/09/dozens-fall-ill-after-7-tons-of-toxic-chemicals-leak-into-water-near-fujian-fishing (Shanghaiist)]

;International relations
*[[New Caledonian independence referendum, 2018]]
**[[New Caledonia]]ns vote against becoming an independent country from [[France]]. [http://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-46087053 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis]]
**The leading judge presiding over the investigation of the [[Catalan independence referendum, 2017|2017 Catalan independence referendum]] and the director of the [[Operation Anubis]] [[Juan Antonio Ramírez Sunyer]] dies suddenly at the age of 71. [https://www.elmundo.es/cataluna/2018/11/04/5bdebb68e5fdead3788b45ca.html (''El Mundo'')]
*[[Corruption in Ukraine]]
**[[Kateryna Handzyuk]], an anti-corruption activist, dies of the injuries that she suffered in an acid attack on 31 July in [[Kherson]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-46091074 (BBC)]
*[[Bahraini uprising of 2011]]
**[[Bahrain]]'s [[Judiciary of Bahrain|Court of Appeal]] rules that the former leader of the now outlawed [[Al-Wefaq]] party, [[Ali Salman|Sheikh Ali Salman]], will receive a life sentence over his conviction for 2011 spying for [[Qatar]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-46088430 (BBC)]
